name: com.ahmedafifi.clan-system
description: Server-authoritative clans, chat and voice on Unity Gaming Services. Clan records, rosters, invites and moderation live in Cloud Save behind Cloud Code, so a client cannot read another clan's roster or write its own membership. Text and voice share one Vivox transport. Ships the Cloud Code scripts the backend needs, a UI Toolkit social window, and a Play Mode suite that runs against the live backend.
